Apply Development-Stage Infection Window to Rc

Source: R/seir.R
dot-apply_infection_window.Rd

If infection_window is provided, multiplies Rc by 1 when dvs_start <= DVS <= dvs_end, else by 0. DVS values are taken from age_values when age_driver = "dvs", otherwise computed from weather and thermal_time.

Usage

.apply_infection_window(
  Rc,
  infection_window,
  age_driver,
  age_values,
  w,
  thermal_time
)

Arguments

Rc

Numeric vector of daily infection rates.

infection_window

NULL or list with dvs_start, dvs_end.

age_driver

Character scalar: "day" or "dvs".

age_values

Numeric age vector.

w

Weather data used when DVS must be computed.

thermal_time

Thermal-time list for DVS calculation.

Value

Numeric vector of gated infection rates (Rc).

Details

Internal helper that gates daily infection rates by a DVS susceptibility window.

See also

seir(), .calculate_dvs()
